name: USB port of a laptop / PC (5 V, 0.5 A)
description: Power from a computer USB port: fine for a microcontroller and sensors, not for servos or motors.
notes: USB 2.0 allows 500 mA at 4.75-5.25 V (USB 3.x: 900 mA). The dev board itself takes part of it.
Never power servos or motors from USB: stall current makes the laptop cut the port or resets the board.
If the project also has its own supply, join grounds but never connect two 5 V sources together.

pins.name: 5V

pins.note: USB 2.0 port: 500 mA guaranteed (USB 3.x: 900 mA). Many laptops shut the port off above that.
